overall_reason: Visitor mode inferred as Persuade: the sweep's INT-001 Floor hits ('35% less' for Deel, '50% more demo efficiency' for Storyblok, '99.99% uptime SLA') are named customers' case-study figures beside 'Read the story' links and a contractual enterprise term, and the stat_band hit on 4.5, 4.8 and 4.5 is three ratings that each name their platform (Trustpilot, Product Hunt, G2), so I judge them to be the brand's own real claims; only the Deel ARR line overstates what it shows.

score.reason: T-PROOF-SOURCE and T-PROOF-SWAP pass on named, linked testimonials and case studies; T-FIGURE-AUDIT fails once on the Deel ARR figure (INT-011). I dispute the sweep's three INT-001 Floors, so the score is not capped here.

findings.where: Deel case card figcaption (shot-1440.png, y 7761) and enterprise case list h3 (shot-1440.png, y 11790), 1440
findings.evidence: The Deel case shows 'From $500M to $1.5B+' as its headline figure, and the enterprise section repeats 'Deel / From $500M to $1.5B+ ARR' beside 'Retell AI / 10M+ calls handled per month'. The figure is Deel's own revenue growth: the page gives no years and does not say what Cal.com contributed to it, while the same case's scheduling result ('35% less time', '6,000+ hours saved per week') is what Cal.com measured.
findings.after: Lead with the scheduling result Cal.com affected, or give the years and label the ARR as Deel's growth over that period
findings.why: A visitor reads a customer's revenue growth as a result of the product, which the page does not claim outright and cannot show.

strengths: Every testimonial card names the person and the platform it came from ('on Trustpilot', 'on Product Hunt', '@kentcdodds on X'), and the Trustpilot cards link to the review URLs.
The logo wall (Vercel, PlanetScale, Framer, Raycast, Ramp, Rho, Udemy) sits on 'Case study' links, and the case cards for Deel and Retell AI end in 'Read the story'.
The free tier's terms appear on the first screen and again at the end: 'No credit card required.' and 'Free for individuals, no credit card, no usage limits.'
The footer shows live status ('All systems operational') and real contact addresses (support@, security@, privacy@ and press@cal.com).
not_investigated: T-PRICE-WHOLE: the home page states only the free tier; the paid plans are on /pricing, not captured.
T-FAKE-SEND: the one form made 11 requests and showed no new text; the sweep's fake_send found no hit.
The booking demo profile ('Get Rickrolled | Rick Astley, cal.com/rick') and the inbox demo (Clara Voss, Felix Moreau) are product illustrations, not judged as claims.
Sections below y 10800 are outside the tiles; I read them on shot-1440.png and in the DOM.

checkout, sign-up and cancellation flows beyond the captured page
